title: Rewire Your Identity
voiceover_full: You don't fail because of a lack of discipline. You fail because you're fighting your own identity. True self-mastery begins when you stop trying to change your habits and start changing who you believe you are. Act like the person you intend to become, long before the world sees it. Master your mind first.
